currentPage.zh-CN: 当前页码，可用 `bind:currentPage` 双向绑定；不传时由组件自己管理页码，用 `bind:currentPage={get, set}` 完全受控。
currentPage.en-US: Current page, bound with `bind:currentPage`. When omitted the component manages the page itself; `bind:currentPage={get, set}` makes it fully controlled.

hideOnSinglePage.zh-CN: 总页数小于 2 时是否隐藏分页器；每页条数选择器显示时不生效。
hideOnSinglePage.en-US: Whether to hide the pagination when there are fewer than 2 pages; has no effect while the size changer is shown.

hoverShowPageSelect.zh-CN: 仅 size 为 small 时生效：悬停或聚焦页码文字时打开页码列表。
hoverShowPageSelect.en-US: Only for size small: the page list opens when the page text is hovered or focused.

nextText.zh-CN: 替换下一页按钮图标的字符串或 snippet，命名规则同 prevText。
nextText.en-US: String or snippet that replaces the next page icon, named the same way as prevText.

onChange.zh-CN: 页码或每页条数变化时调用，参数为页码与每页条数。
onChange.en-US: Called when the page or the page size changes, with the page and the page size.

onPageSizeChange.en-US: Called when the page size changes.

pageSize.zh-CN: 每页条数，可用 `bind:pageSize` 绑定，选择器的选择会写回；未传时取 pageSizeOpts 的第一项。
pageSize.en-US: Number of items per page, bound with `bind:pageSize`; the choice made in the size changer is written back. Falls back to the first item of pageSizeOpts.

pageSizeOpts.zh-CN: 每页条数选择器的可选值；当前每页条数不在其中时按大小插入选项。
pageSizeOpts.en-US: Options of the size changer; the current page size is inserted in order when it is not among them.

popoverPosition.zh-CN: 省略页码浮层与每页条数下拉的位置；size 为 small 时不使用。
popoverPosition.en-US: Position of the omitted pages popover and the size changer dropdown; not used by the small size.

preventPageChangeOnPageSizeChange.zh-CN: 切换每页条数时保持当前页码，新页码由使用方在 onPageSizeChange 中决定。
preventPageChangeOnPageSizeChange.en-US: Keeps the current page when the page size changes; the consumer picks the page in onPageSizeChange.

prevText.zh-CN: 替换上一页按钮图标的字符串或 snippet。字符串或纯文本 snippet 作为按钮名称，其他内容（图标、元素）仍使用语言包的名称；传入空 snippet 时按钮为空，空字符串则显示默认图标。
prevText.en-US: String or snippet that replaces the previous page icon. A string or a plain-text snippet names the button, and any other content (an icon, an element) keeps the locale name; an empty snippet leaves the button empty, an empty string shows the default icon.

showQuickJumper.zh-CN: 是否显示快速跳转输入框，总页数小于 2 时禁用。
showQuickJumper.en-US: Whether to show the quick jump input; disabled when there are fewer than 2 pages.

showSizeChanger.zh-CN: 是否显示每页条数选择器，size 为 small 时不显示。
showSizeChanger.en-US: Whether to show the size changer; not rendered when size is small.

showTotal.zh-CN: 是否显示总页数，size 为 small 时不显示。
showTotal.en-US: Whether to show the total number of pages; not shown when size is small.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default 或 small。
